## Review checklist

- [ ] The governing ADR was accepted before implementation began, or the change is purely editorial.
- [ ] Evidence proves the affected invariants rather than repeating ADR prose.
- [ ] Relevant Rust, Node, documentation, and evidence checks pass.
- [ ] No secrets or credentials are committed.
